status: built a non-editable wheel runtime, captured it, produced and verified a real macOS user deployment bundle, and passed the read-only service acceptance with --expect absent; nothing was installed, enabled or loaded
procedure: python -m venv temp/build/svc-venv3 with the resolved CPython 3.12.16 interpreter; bin/python rewritten to that real path
temp/build/svc-venv3/bin/python -m omni.composition.cli service plan request.json runtime.json plan.json
temp/build/svc-venv3/bin/python -m omni.composition.cli service materialize plan.json temp/build/service/deployment
findings: materialize requires the destination to be exactly the request bundle_dir; a different directory returns deployment_location_mismatch
the acceptance script must run under the deployment runtime: from the source/editable venv its verify captures that runtime and returns deployment_path_unsafe -> deployment_not_eligible

uv-created venvs symlink through the uv managed alias path, whose parent is itself a symlink; capture rejects that chain. A python -m venv created from the resolved interpreter, with bin/python rewritten, captured cleanly
service verify also only reports valid/eligible when the running program equals the plan runtime
limits: Nothing was installed: registered/loaded/ready, enable override, login activation and unload remain unexercised.
The deployment bundle lives under temp/build, not an immutable production installation directory; a real installation still needs an isolated account and an owner-approved apply-operation.
The helper's Accessibility/input/post grants are still pending, so the runtime readiness probe would report desktop denial even if a service were started.
Gitee push remains blocked without an HTTPS credential; delivery is local only.
Not whole-platform or whole-V2 acceptance; the 72-hour requirement remains open.
